Title: WebFOCUS
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-webfocus
Content: The connector processes .trc, .acx and .mas files (generating .trc files is explained in detail in the Setup Page). The .trc files contain the runtime fex file commands that were executed by WebFOCUS. The connector takes these commands and infers column-level lineage from them, with assistance from the master .mas and .acx files, which specify the logical and physical data sources respectively.

The connector is a file-based connector only. It does not connect to WebFOCUS directly. Instead, it relies on input files provided to it.

Files must be available on the connector-accessible file-system. Upload of files is not supported.
Title: Configuration
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-webfocus/configuration
Content: solidatus.webfocus.ignore-connector-level-config-sources: If set to true and in agent mode, during job execution, any access/master file sources from the connector-level config will be ignored and only access/master file sources from the job-level config will be used.
solidatus.webfocus.create-data-assets: By default, when true, creates Data Assets in the Solidatus model. Set to false to disable Data Asset creation.
solidatus.webfocus.access-file-sources.treat-parsing-errors-as-warnings: By default, when false, ANTLR's parsing errors will throw an exception and terminate execution. Set to true to treat parsing errors as warnings instead. ANTLR will do its best to parse the input regardless and processing will continue.
solidatus.webfocus.access-file-sources.source-paths: A list of source path objects
solidatus.webfocus.master-file-sources.treat-parsing-errors-as-warnings: By default, when false, ANTLR's parsing errors will throw an exception and terminate execution. Set to true to treat parsing errors as warnings instead. ANTLR will do its best to parse the input regardless and processing will continue.
solidatus.webfocus.master-file-sources.source-paths: A list of source path objects
solidatus.webfocus.trace-file-sources: trace file sources object
Title: WebFOCUS
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-2026.1/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-webfocus
Content: The Solidatus connector for WebFOCUS generates a Solidatus model by extracting column-level lineage from WebFOCUS report (.fex/.trc) and metadata (.mas, .acx) files. The connector enables modelling and exploration of data flows with the powerful Solidatus tools, as well as integration with lineage from other sources once inside Solidatus.

The WebFOCUS Connector extracts Runtime lineage. This is different from static lineage - lineage is only drawn from what is executed, and may miss areas that were not executed. This relies on the generation of .trc files, which are traces generated from a fex report, and represent the actual fex queries that were run on report generation. Generating .trc files is explained here.

Title: Requirements
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-2026.2/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-webfocus/requirements
Content: The connector requires WebFOCUS trace files (.trc) as input to extract lineage. These files are generated during WebFOCUS report (.fex) execution, and represent the actual commands executed by WebFOCUS. Generating trace files is explained in detail in the Setup Page.
